# BurgerAPI Documentation

BurgerAPI is a Bun-native API framework with file-based routing, a hybrid router, a shared request context, Zod validation, and automatic OpenAPI generation. Current version: 0.11.0.

## Getting Started
- Introduction: https://burger-api.com/docs/
- Quick Start: https://burger-api.com/docs/quick-start
- Installation: https://burger-api.com/docs/getting-started/installation
- Key Concepts: https://burger-api.com/docs/key-concepts
- CLI Quick Start: https://burger-api.com/docs/getting-started/cli
